code-review.note: Fable and Sonnet name Claude reviewers. Use the required provider/model when available. If unavailable, mark that review incomplete; do not label a Codex self-review as a Claude review. Follow the source workflow for roles and local Codex instructions for actual callable tools.

delivery-workflow.note: Preserve the source workflow and publication confirmation. Use native Codex tool names; source tool permissions are not Codex grants. Do not publish or change approval settings merely because this skill is loaded.

expand-tool-output.note: This skill can read existing Claude archive IDs only when the local Claude archive helper is installed. It does not enable a Codex compaction hook. If the archive/helper is unavailable, report the missing dependency instead of guessing output.

prepare-compaction.note: In Codex, use a task-local handoff file for compaction. Do not write Claude auto-memory or Codex memories without an explicit user request. Follow the host compaction controls; source slash commands are not executable shell commands.

ticket.note: Read the machine-local reference.md next to this installed skill before using connectors. Its absence makes the skill unavailable. Use the equivalent installed Jira/Notion connector only if available and authorized; do not invent server names or workspace IDs. Local Claude snapshot paths stay local and are not generated.
